methodology: The study utilized a modified genetic algorithm (MGA) to design fibers with desired dispersion parameters. The optimization process involved four fiber parameters and resulted in the construction of a fiber for which HE mode dispersion is anomalous in the 1.735-5.155µm range.
research_objective: To optimize dispersion tailoring for highly nonlinear chalcogenide glass fibers, specifically for high-order modes (HE) where LP mode approximation fails due to large refractive index contrasts.
